title: Add a state, overlay or step variant of a screen
trigger: A screen needs its empty, error or dialog state.
goal: The state lives next to its parent in the sidebar tree.
outcome: A variant screen with variant_of and variant_kind, nested under its parent.

steps.action: Writes the variant screen with stable structural ids
Sets variant_of and variant_kind with set_meta
Nests the variant under its parent in the sidebar
